title: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. filed an 8-K on April 9, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Gateway for Accelerated Innovations in Nuclear (GAIN) Voucher (NE-26-38854) from the U.S. Department of Energy. The voucher supports the company's KRONOS MMR™ Energy System design project using Oak Ridge National Laboratory's SCALE/TSUNAMI tools.
